thread:
tay: Heads-up: partner S3 ingestion webhook delivered a payload that includes a field matching our KMS-wrapped key format. Found in logs: partner-uploads/ingest-2026-04-02/payload-8791.json

nora: can you paste the snippet (sanitized)?

tay: excerpt: "client_key_enc": "CiQAqW...base64...=="  looks like our KMS envelope (CiQA prefix). Partner said they anonymize, but this looks like our wrapped private key got captured.

evan: treat as exposed until proven otherwise. key is likely a service TLS key used by partner proxy. steps: 1) revoke key material / rotate certs 2) provision new key and wrap with new KMS key 3) update partner webhook to use new cert 4) run audit for any decrypt calls and object reads.

sec-bot: @tay flagged object partner-uploads/2026-04-02/payload-8791.json -> potential wrapped key leak. Severity: high.

infra-oncall: agree with evan. Also do RBAC lockdown: remove cryptoKeyDecrypter role from any partner principals on the key used to wrap this ciphertext. We'll snapshot IAM before change.

tay: I traced the ciphertext header to projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/webhooks/cryptoKeys/webhook-client-key. Running KMS audit now for Decrypt in last 90d.

nora: partner access model: they had read to the webhook payload store, not to KMS. That lowers risk but we still assume compromise. Partner ingestion code stored the wrapped blob verbatim in payload. We need to update onboarding docs.

evan: rotation plan skew: certificates mean we must update TLS cert used by partner proxy. Two options: 1) rotate private key and reissue cert (shorter breakage), 2) create a new keypair + new cert and swap both sides. Prefer new keypair + new cert and phased rollout.

infra-oncall: plan: create new keypair, store new private key wrapped by a fresh KMS key (new keyring webhooks-rotate-042), push wrapped blob via secure channel to partner staging, update partner to pull, run smoke tests, then cut over, then revoke old cert/key and remove partner read from old Vault path.

sec-bot: Incident channel pinged: INC-2026-0412 created and posted to #incidents and #product-security.

tay: assigning: infra-oncall -> IAM snapshot + RBAC change, nora -> partner comms + staging validation, evan -> cert/key creation + rewrap scripts, tay -> Vault updates + audit exports.

neora: (typo) nora: acknowledged. I'll DM partner-eng to request pause on webhook delivery and ask for ingestion logs. Also ask them not to re-send payloads containing client_key_enc.

evan: example commands I'll run (gcloud/Vault sketch):
```
# generate keypair
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out client-rotated.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048
openssl req -new -x509 -key client-rotated.key -out client-rotated.crt -days 365 -subj "/CN=partner-proxy"
# wrap private key
gcloud kms keyrings create webhooks-rotate-042 --location=global || true
gcloud kms keys create rotate-key-042 --location=global --keyring=webhooks-rotate-042 --purpose=encryption
gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=webhooks-rotate-042 --key=rotate-key-042 --plaintext-file=client-rotated.key --ciphertext-file=client-rotated.key.enc
# push to vault
vault kv put secret/data/webhooks/partner-x client_key_enc=@client-rotated.key.enc
```

infra-oncall: IAM snapshot saved: /tmp/iam-snapshot-2925001111.json. Proceeding to remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from partner principals on the key webhooks/cryptoKeys/webhook-client-key. Change logged as CHG-2925-KMS-LOCK.

tay: updated Vault policy: revoked partner read on secret/data/webhooks/partner-x for old path. Created new path secret/data/webhooks/partner-x/v2 and granted read only to the new rotated SA after verification. Logged as CHG-2925-VAULT.

nora: partner confirmed pause and requested staged test. I'll provision a short-lived staging token for them to fetch the new wrapped blob from our staging bucket. Will not re-grant Vault path until we validate their code doesn't persist wrapped blobs in payloads.

evan: smoke test plan: partner pulls new wrapped blob, unwrap is internal (we do not give them KMS decrypt), partner uses private key locally in their proxy container. We'll validate TLS handshake to our staging endpoint. If successful, schedule production swap during maintenance window.

infra-oncall: logging check: no Decrypt calls from external principals. KMS decrypt calls only from internal CA issuance service in last 90 days. Still proceed with rotate.

sec-bot: Suggestion: add detection rule to scanning pipeline to flag any payloads/artifacts containing base64 strings starting with KMS header prefixes (CiQA/CiQB). Creating ticket SEC-2925-DET.

tay: timeline: aiming for rollout within 3 hours. Partner agreed to a 1h maintenance window this afternoon. I'll coordinate.

nora: after rotate, we should run a targeted S3 payload scan for prior days (last 14d) to identify any other occurrences of wrapped blobs. I'll run a CLI search and report results.

evan: also create CRL/update revocation for old cert. We'll mark old cert as revoked in our CA and remove from trusted bundle for 24h post-rotate.

infra-oncall: completed rotation at 14:22 PT. new keypair and cert created, private key wrapped with rotate-key-042 and stored in secret/data/webhooks/partner-x/v2. Partner pulled via secure staging URL and validated handshake. Old SA keys disabled and old Vault path access removed.

tay: post-rotate audit: S3 payload search found two other payloads with similar ciphertext in last 7 days. Both in partner-uploads/2026-03-28 and partner-uploads/2026-03-31. I quarantined those objects and notified partner.

nora: follow-ups: 1) update partner onboarding docs: forbid storing wrapped keys in webhook payloads 2) add automatic payload scanner at ingress to reject payloads containing KMS header patterns 3) add Vault policy templates that prevent partner-scoped paths from containing ciphertext-looking values.

evan: I also created a small helper script to generate and wrap keys consistently for partners and added it to infra repo with a pre-approved review to avoid ad-hoc wrapping. Ticket INFRA-2925-HELPER.

sec-bot: INC-2026-0412 status -> resolved (rotation complete, partner validated). Follow-ups created: SEC-2925-DET, DOC-2925-ONBOARD, INFRA-2925-HELPER.

tay: closing thread. Good job everyone. Please keep related logs and evidence in gs://sec-incident/2925001111 for 90 days. :white_check_mark:
